verdict.rationale: Marqeta is an API-first payments platform, so a downloadable OpenAPI spec is a fair question to ask of it. However, no evidence documents one: probes of common OpenAPI and Swagger paths all returned 404. The interactive browser widgets and the MCP server are related features, not a machine-readable spec download, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
